title: Coordinated Junta Airstrikes Across Rakhine, Mandalay and Sagaing Kill 6 Civilians, Injure 26+
detail: Junta forces conducted coordinated airstrikes across three regions on July 19, 2026: Mahlaing Township (Mandalay Region, roughly 75 miles south of Mandalay city); Myaung and Chaung-U townships (Sagaing Region, 16-36 miles south of Monywa), where 60+ bombs were dropped; and Taungup, Thandwe, and Ponnagyun townships in Rakhine State. In total, 6 civilians were killed (including a 70-year-old man in Mahlaing) and 26+ were injured, including children and Buddhist monks, with 25+ homes and a church destroyed. Cumulative civilian casualties since junta chief Min Aung Hlaing's April 20 'peace offer' reached 274 deaths and 579 injuries from airstrikes alone.

media.caption: Coordinated junta airstrikes across Rakhine, Mandalay and Sagaing kill 6 civilians.

title: Junta Fighter Jet Drops 500-Pound Bombs on Ma-Ei Town, Toungup Township — 5 Killed
detail: At approximately 11:30am on July 19, 2026, a junta fighter jet dropped three 500-pound bombs on Wards 2 and 3 of Ma-Ei town, Toungup Township, Rakhine State, killing 5 people — Maung Htun Lin Zaw (17), Ma La Pyae San (19), Ko Nyi Nyi Htwe (19), Ma Mu Mu Htay (35), and Ko Nyi Nyi Zaw (34) — and injuring 14 others, including a wounded Buddhist monk (Ashin Kawida). More than 10 houses were damaged. In response, the Arakan Army publicly vowed to 'respond to every military assault on AA-controlled territory' in collaboration with partner organizations.

media.caption: Junta fighter jet bombs Ma-Ei town, Toungup Township, killing 5 including a wounded monk.
